1: // Simple Asteroid Escape game
2: // Canvas with id="game" is expected in the HTML.
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   // sound assets (data URIs)
8:   const crashSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='); // silent placeholder beep
9:   const spawnSound = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
10:   const W = canvas.width = canvas.width || 400;
11:   const H = canvas.height = canvas.height || 600;
12: 
13:   // player ship
14:   const ship = { w: 40, h: 20, x: W / 2, y: H - 30, speed: 5, dx: 0 };
15: 
16:   // input handling
17:   const keys = {};
18:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') keys[e.key] = true; });
19:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowRight') keys[e.key] = false; });
20: 
21:   // stars background
22:   const stars = [];
23:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
24:     stars.push({
25:       x: Math.random() * W,
26:       y: Math.random() * H,
27:       r: Math.random() * 2 + 1,
28:       speed: Math.random() * 0.5 + 0.2
29:     });
30:   }
31: 
32:   // asteroids
33:   const asteroids = [];
34:   let spawnTimer = 0;
35:   let spawnInterval = 90; // frames
36:   let speedInc = 0.02;
37:   let score = 0;
38:   let startTime = performance.now();
39:   let gameOver = false;
40: 
41:   function spawnAsteroid() {
42:     spawnSound.currentTime = 0;
43:     spawnSound.play();
44:     const radius = 10 + Math.random() * 15;
45:     const x = Math.random() * (W - radius * 2) + radius;
46:     const y = -radius;
47:     const speed = 2 + Math.random() * 2 + (score / 1000);
48:     asteroids.push({ x, y, radius, speed });
49:   }
50: 
51:   function update() {
52:     // move stars
53:     stars.forEach(s => {
54:       s.y += s.speed;
55:       if (s.y > H) {
56:         s.y = 0;
57:         s.x = Math.random() * W;
58:       }
59:     });
60:     // player movement
61:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.dx = -ship.speed;
62:     else if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.dx = ship.speed;
63:     else ship.dx = 0;
64:     ship.x = Math.max(0, Math.min(W - ship.w, ship.x + ship.dx));
65: 
66:     // asteroids
67:     spawnTimer++;
68:     if (spawnTimer >= spawnInterval) { spawnAsteroid(); spawnTimer = 0; }
69:     spawnInterval = Math.max(30, spawnInterval - speedInc);
70:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
71:       const a = asteroids[i];
72:       a.y += a.speed;
73:       // collision with ship
74:       if (
75:         a.y + a.radius > ship.y &&
76:         a.x > ship.x && a.x < ship.x + ship.w
77:       ) {
78:         crashSound.currentTime = 0;
79:         crashSound.play();
80:         gameOver = true;
81:       }
82:       // remove if offscreen
83:       if (a.y - a.radius > H) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
84:     }
85: 
86:     // score based on time survived
87:     score = Math.floor((performance.now() - startTime) / 1000);
88:   }
89: 
90: function draw() {
91:     // background already filled in update
92:     // draw stars
93:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
94:     stars.forEach(s => {
95:       ctx.beginPath();
96:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
97:       ctx.fill();
98:     });
99:     // ship (triangle drawn in update)
100:     // ship already drawn in its own code block earlier; we'll redraw here
101:     // ship
102:     ctx.fillStyle = '#0f0';
103:     ctx.beginPath();
104:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h);
105:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w / 2, ship.y);
106:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);
107:     ctx.closePath();
108:     ctx.fill();
109:     // asteroids with radial gradient
110:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
111:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(a.x, a.y, a.radius * 0.2, a.x, a.y, a.radius);
112:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
113:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
114:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
115:       ctx.beginPath();
116:       ctx.arc(a.x, a.y, a.radius, 0, Math.PI * 2);
117:       ctx.fill();
118:     });
119:     // score
120:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
121:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
122:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
123:     if (gameOver) {
124:       ctx.fillStyle = 'red';
125:       ctx.font = '30px sans-serif';
126:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', W / 2 - 80, H / 2);
127:     }
128:   }
129:   }
130: 
131:   function loop() {
132:     if (!gameOver) update();
133:     draw();
134:     if (!gameOver) requestAnimationFrame(loop);
135:   }
136: 
137:   loop();
138: })();

(End of file - total 138 lines)
